elements.element: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation imposed on Customer
elements.evidence: "Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

elements.element: No de facto exclusivity mechanic (right of first refusal / disclose-and-match) binding Customer
elements.evidence: "Customer is not required to disclose or match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives."

elements.element: No restriction on Customer engaging other suppliers or conducting business in any field/territory
elements.evidence: "Nothing restricts Customer from ... engaging any supplier, ... or conducting business in any field or territory."

elements.element: Any exclusivity confined to a defined product category
elements.evidence: Condition absent: no exclusivity exists — "Customer has made no exclusivity ... commitment."
Condition absent: no exclusivity term is imposed anywhere in 7.2 or 12.3.

elements.element: Automatic termination of exclusivity on Vendor's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates
elements.evidence: Condition absent: no exclusivity to terminate — "Nothing restricts Customer from ... engaging any supplier".

reasons: The single replacement in 7.2 flips the disclose-and-match obligation into an express negation, removing the de facto right of first refusal / exclusivity mechanic on Customer; the preferred position (no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation) is therefore met.
Fallback elements are vacuously satisfied because no exclusivity obligation exists in the document; the drafter correctly did not invent a limited exclusivity.
Minimality holds: only the operative verb phrase of one sentence was changed, no new exceptions, no boilerplate, and Section 12.3 was left untouched.

Intent preserved: the residual introductory phrase "Before engaging another provider" is harmless surplusage and the negation is consistent with Vendor's acknowledgement in 12.3; no undefined terms or dangling mechanics introduced. A simple deletion of the 7.2 sentence would have been equally clean, but the flip is not materially broader.
